snippet.title: KRAA Gameplay Trailer (2026)
snippet.description:
A short atmospheric game about a murder of crows in an uncertain world.

Fly above the landscape, explore, gather all your corvid friends and find a place to rest in safety. And above all, enjoy the view.

Available for FREE on Itch.io
https://buldozer.itch.io/kraa
